# 2 Baruch Chapter 33 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 33 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 33:1 — Single verse — minimal divergence

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I-went-away and-I-sat in-the-valley of-Kidron in-a-cave of-the-earth" | Preserves the Syriac word order: valley first, then cave |
| LOGOS | "I went away and sat in a cave of the earth in the valley of Kidron" | Slight reorder for English clarity |
| PNEUMA | "I withdrew again and sat in a cave in the Kidron valley" | Omits "of the earth" qualifier; adds "again" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The full phrase "cave of the earth" is in the Syriac and distinguishes an earthen cave from other kinds; PNEUMA's omission loses this. EMET's word order is Syriac-natural but LOGOS is equally accurate and more English-idiomatic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Minor variation, single-verse chapter.
